title: Natural-language launch acceptance preparation
protocol: Separate launch acceptance suite; not FBS v1.0 and not a comparative benchmark.
routing_policy: Every route is a declared hypothesis. Record actual discovery/routing only when the host exposes it; do not infer a loaded skill from fluent output.

execution_policy.candidate_host: Run one case in a fresh, disposable host session with the actual candidate installed. Record the exact candidate and host, the available tools, permissions, raw prompts and outputs, and acceptance evidence. If the required tool setup cannot be reproduced, mark the run blocked rather than substitute a successful result.
execution_policy.synthetic_fixture: Exercises setup or validators only. Label every fixture and exclude it from host-completion counts, routing observations, performance claims and independent-user evidence.
execution_policy.comparison: None planned by this file. A controlled baseline/terse/Fabius experiment requires a separate budget, protocol and receipts.
execution_policy.safety: Use supplied synthetic inputs and disposable files. No real secrets, personal customer data, external messages, account mutations, installation changes or paid calls are authorized by this suite.

candidate-host.claim_scope: Only the observed case and recorded host configuration; maintainer execution is not independent-user validation.

synthetic-fixture.claim_scope: Infrastructure validation only; never a candidate-host result.
